core: DNA double-strand break sensing, end processing and repair
qualifier: BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects and protein ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break repair, BRCA1/2 defects and protein ADP-ribosylation
rationale: All members concern sensing, resection and repair of DNA double-strand breaks by HR, NHEJ, SSA or MMEJ and their regulation by PARylation, and the BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function and ADP-ribosylation members distinguish it from the replication-stress, interstrand cross-link and Fanconi confusables.

qualifier: myeloid differentiation and colony-stimulating factor production
name: Bone marrow myelopoiesis and colony-stimulating factor production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow development, cell proliferation and survival there and myeloid (macrophage, dendritic cell) fate with M-CSF and G-CSF production, unlike confusables centred on stem-cell homeostasis, CSF receptor signalling or RUNX1/erythroid programmes.

qualifier: phosphatidylethanolamine acyl-chain remodelling
name: Phosphatidylethanolamine acyl-chain remodelling in glycerophospholipid metabolism
rationale: All three members concern glycerophospholipid metabolism focused on PE acyl-chain remodelling, distinguishing it from confusables about DAG/TAG and phosphatidic acid synthesis or eicosanoid metabolism.

qualifier: Trk receptor (TRKA/TRKB/TRKC) pro-survival and growth output
name: Neurotrophin Trk receptor pro-survival signalling
rationale: Members are NGF, BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 signalling through TRKA, TRKB and TRKC to RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5 and CREB and NF-kB survival, unlike confusables centred on p75NTR death and dependence-receptor signalling or generic MAPK cascades.

qualifier: osteoclast differentiation and resorption with insulin-like growth factor response
name: Osteoclast-mediated bone remodelling and insulin-like growth factor response
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption, bone mineralization and chondrocyte development alongside IGF responses, distinguishing it from osteoblast, odontogenesis and Wnt/mesenchymal confusables.

qualifier: GPER1 and progesterone receptor signalling, estrous cycle
name: Estrogen, GPER1 and progesterone receptor signalling
rationale: Members concern estrogen nuclear and GPER1 signalling, progesterone receptor signalling and the estrous cycle, which separates it from androgen-receptor and hallmark estrogen-response confusables.

core: Cellular response to ultraviolet and visible light
qualifier: including phorbol ester response
name: Ultraviolet, blue light and phorbol ester stress response
rationale: Members are responses to UV-A, UV-B, blue light and phorbol ester (immediate-early stress responses), distinguishing it from TNF/NF-kB, liver regeneration and MITF melanocyte confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin K catabolism and vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: All members concern vitamin K metabolism and the gamma-carboxylation, transport and propeptide removal of vitamin K-dependent proteins, unlike confusables on isoprenoid/quinone synthesis, coagulation or vitamins E and C.

qualifier: membrane contact sites and non-vesicular lipid transfer
name: Endoplasmic reticulum shaping and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover ER tubular network formation and fusion, ER-mitochondria and ER-plasma membrane tethering with Miro GTPases, and PI/PC/cholesterol transfer and PI synthesis at the ER, distinguishing it from Golgi traffic, inositol phosphate and flippase confusables.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and vessel remodelling
name: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching and remodelling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation, apoptosis and phenotypic switching with blood vessel remodelling, distinguishing it from cardiac muscle and endothelial angiogenesis confusables.

qualifier: phagocytic amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Microglial activation, amyloid fibril regulation and phagocytic clearance
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity together with amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance and amyloid fibril formation, distinguishing it from confusables on amyloid production, APP processing and astrocyte regulation.

qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and creatine-phosphocreatine shuttle
name: Adenine nucleotide phosphotransfer and creatine-phosphocreatine energy shuttle
rationale: Members concern phosphoryl transfer among nucleotides, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and phosphocreatine metabolism, the creatine shuttle distinguishing it from NAD, GTP and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: p75NTR/proNGF and ligand-free dependence receptors
name: Neurotrophin receptor death signalling via p75NTR and dependence receptors
rationale: Members concern proNGF/p75NTR pro-apoptotic signalling (NRAGE-JNK, NADE, ceramide) and caspase activation by unliganded NTRK3 and other dependence receptors, distinguishing it from Trk pro-survival and axon-regeneration confusables.

qualifier: bacterial agglutination, epithelial attachment and cytolysis
name: Mucosal epithelial antibacterial defence by agglutination and cytolysis
rationale: Members concern host interaction with bacteria at mucosal epithelia through attachment, agglutination and cytolysis, distinguishing it from defensin, metal-sequestration and neutrophil-killing confusables.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelial cells and mucociliary clearance
name: Multiciliated epithelial cell ciliogenesis and mucociliary clearance
rationale: Members cover multiciliogenesis transcription, de novo centriole and basal body assembly, dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance, distinguishing it from sperm axoneme and left-right asymmetry cilia confusables.

qualifier: generic, not tied to a specific amino acid
name: Generic L-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three members are obsolete umbrella terms for alpha/L-amino acid metabolism and catabolism, distinguished from confusables only by lacking any specific amino acid such as phenylalanine, tyrosine, proline or glycine.

qualifier: definitive endoderm, lateral mesoderm and gut tube morphogenesis
name: Definitive endoderm, lateral mesoderm and embryonic gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak and gastrulation, endoderm specification, lateral plate mesoderm and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis, distinguishing it from pluripotency, EMT and cardiac/axial mesoderm confusables.

core: Innate immune receptor signalling to NF-kappaB
qualifier: IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1 relay to JNK/p38 including TRIF and inflammasome inputs
name: Toll-like receptor TRAF6-TAK1 relay to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF-, ALPK1- and inflammasome-linked IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1-IKK steps with K63 ubiquitination and JNK/p38 activation, distinguishing it from NOD1/2, TNFR1/non-canonical NF-kB and cytokine-production confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily, RHOD and Rnd atypical GTPases
name: CDC42-subfamily, RHOD and Rnd atypical GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 with formin/IQGAP effectors and Rac antagonism, distinguishing it from RhoA/B/C and Rac-centred confusables.

qualifier: histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD/NuRD remodelling
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD chromatin remodelling
rationale: Members concern histone lysine methyltransferases and demethylases, HDACs, WDR5/MLL complexes and CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodellers with X inactivation, distinguishing it from DNA methylation/PRC2, arginine methylation and BAF complex confusables.

qualifier: glial lineages and midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Glial and midbrain dopaminergic neuron fate differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial (oligodendrocyte, astrocyte, Bergmann glia) and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation and precursor proliferation, distinguishing it from forebrain progenitor and Schwann cell/myelination confusables.

qualifier: resting and LPS-activated states
name: Dendritic cell surface signatures, resting and LPS-activated
rationale: Four of five members are resting, activated or generic dendritic cell surface modules and the fifth is a co-clustering T cell module, distinguishing it from B cell and monocyte surface signature confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily and RHOD with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: CDC42-subfamily and RHOD GTPase cycles via formins, IQGAPs
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV and RHOD plus formin and IQGAP activation and G beta:gamma-CDC42 signalling, distinguishing it from RhoA/B/C/G confusables.

qualifier: planar cell polarity, convergent extension and Wnt ligand secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP convergent extension and Wnt ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover Wnt/PCP and Wnt/Ca2+ signalling, convergent extension and epithelial planar polarity with PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, distinguishing it from Nodal left-right, Hedgehog and axial mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: nuclear envelope breakdown/reassembly and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope remodelling, spindle midzone and cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover nuclear lamina and envelope disassembly and ESCRT-mediated resealing, spindle midzone elongation, contractile ring and abscission, distinguishing it from chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle checkpoint confusables.
